display_name: 无路由稠密衍射基线（Dense-OEO，同全局孔径）
statistics: Single seed17, 752 TEST samples per model; no across-seed mean or SD.

architecture_contract.OEO: intensity -> mean normalization -> affine-free spatial LayerNorm -> ReLU -> t/(1+t) -> unit power
architecture_contract.RGB: same encoding function; full dense aperture; source information bandwidth differs from tiled LG
architecture_contract.comparison: Same global aperture and 4 feature layers; expert phase pixels and total parameters are not equal; nonlinear OEO retained in both.

training_contract.selection: Minimum VAL macro-NLL EMA among all 60 epochs
training_contract.TEST_policy: All four training workers completed and exited, one unified checkpoint SHA lock, then one TEST evaluation per model.

migration.RNG: Reseeded through original entry; not bitwise restored

source_identity.discarded_partial_epoch: Not saved and not counted; exact number of discarded gradient inputs unknown
source_identity.RNG: Reseed through original train entry; not bitwise RNG restore

interpretation: This is a post-hoc architecture control with retained OEO nonlinearity, not a passive linear D2NN and not a router-only ablation.
Single-seed aperture rerun does not replace historical three-seed expert_global D2NN statistics.

Compare with original 60-epoch LG seed17 for the paired budget view; current latest LG includes 90-epoch development follow-ups and TEST-trained full-k fits, so do not claim equal training budgets or held-out superiority for that mixed table.
Dense RGB encoding uses a larger spatial sampling grid than the 224x224 LG source; matching aperture does not match source information bandwidth.
Different GPU models and shared utilization are not a fair speed benchmark.
The fixed split does not establish patient-independent generalization.
